name: io.github.cyanheads/inaturalist-mcp-server
description: Search iNaturalist sightings, identification threads, phenology, and look-alike species.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

environmentVariables.name: INATURALIST_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: User-Agent sent on every request to api.inaturalist.org. Defaults to the package name, its version, and the repository URL. Keep a contact URL in any override — the published terms ask for identifiable clients.

environmentVariables.name: INATURALIST_MIN_REQUEST_INTERVAL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum spacing between outbound request starts, in milliseconds. The default holds the sustained rate near 54 requests per minute, under the 60 the upstream asks for and well under its 100 ceiling.

environmentVariables.name: INATURALIST_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum outbound requests in flight. Separate from the start interval: spacing bounds the sustained rate, this bounds the burst so one slow call does not stall the lane.

environmentVariables.name: INATURALIST_DAILY_REQUEST_BUDGET
environmentVariables.description: Outbound requests allowed per UTC day, counted in-process. The default sits under the 10,000 per day the upstream asks for, and exhaustion fails loudly rather than degrading silently.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.
